messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged rollout: redwood-inference-api v2.24 -> v2.25. Canary=6% (split by variant A/B) across global regions. Notes: https://internal/release/2.25 :tada:
nina: change-window 00:30-01:00 UTC. notice that this canary splits traffic by model-variant flag (A/B). tagging ops for variant watch.
ash: telemetry: variant-B shows elevated hallucination rate on a small prompt set (+0.9% false facts) at +7m. link: https://telemetry/evals/variantB?since=10m
paul: interesting. variant-A looks fine. This might be a model variant quality regression, not infra.
ops_south: can we route variant-B traffic down to 0% while leaving variant-A running? want to avoid full rollback if it's variant-specific.
nina: yes, route-level splits support variant overrides. Who can run the variant-weight adjust?
ash: I'll run it and also add a temporary rate limit on variant-B to 1r/s per-client.
ash: Running: ```
# reduce weight for variant-B and rate limit
deployctl traffic set-variant-weight --service redwood-inference-api --variant B --weight 0 --reason "hallucination uptick"
deployctl config set --service redwood-inference-api --variant B --rate_limit_per_client 1
```
deploy-bot: Action executed: variant-B weight set to 0 by nash at 1890012352. Rate limit applied.
qa_bot: quick auto-eval: sample input set shows false-fact rate for variant-B dropped after weight=0 (as expected). Posting proof: https://qa/reports/189001
paul: Good. Recommendation: hold canary and run a focused eval against our regression suite. If variant-B fails, we'll pin variant to A and mark B as blocked.
ops_south: For audit, record rollback commands: regional rollback: `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.24 --scope region:all --variant B` (requires two approvals for global variant rollback).
nina: I'll block automated increments and open an incident to track eval results.
deploy-bot: Auto-advance paused at 1890012365 per request. Current state: global 6% but variant-B traffic weight=0.
ash: kicking off regression eval now. ETA ~12m.
paul: If eval confirms, we should also update release notes and add a line to the changelog: "variant-B blocked due to hallucination regression in canary".
qa_bot: Eval finished: variant-B regression tests failing 14/200 (7%), threshold is 2%. Attaching summary: https://qa/reports/189001/result
paul: That's above threshold. decision: mark variant-B blocked and pin all traffic to variant-A for production. This requires owner approval + lead approval.
ops_south: I approve. nina: do you approve?
nina: Approved. Blocking variant-B and pinning traffic to variant-A now.
ash: Running commands: ```
# block variant-B and pin to A
deployctl variant block --service redwood-inference-api --variant B --reason "regression in canary"
deployctl traffic set-variant-weight --service redwood-inference-api --variant A --weight 100
```
deploy-bot: Variant-B blocked and traffic pinned to variant-A at 1890012388.
paul: release notes updated and change-window annotated. scheduling postmortem to discuss why B regressed.
nina: thanks all. holdcall released for now; will follow up in incident channel with RCA timeline. :white_check_mark:
